source: Its technical report specifies both pre-norm and post-norm with ZXNAME0000XZ: the input and output of each attention and feed-forward sublayer are normalized. It also uses GeGLU rather than ZXNAME0001XZ, ZXNAME0002XZ, and alternating local/global attention layers. [16]
zh: 其技术报告用 ZXNAME0000XZ 指定了前规范和后规范：每个注意力和前馈子层的输入和输出都被规范化。它还使用 GeGLU 而不是 ZXNAME0001XZ、ZXNAME0002XZ 和交替的局部/全局注意力层。 [16]
